questions: Are you fully conscious and aware during these movements?
Do you remember everything that happens during an episode?
Did they start after an injury, illness, emotional shock, or medical procedure?
Do they stop when you are asleep?
Have you ever had similar episodes before?
Do you have weakness or loss of sensation on one side of your body?
Do you have difficulty speaking, seeing, swallowing, or breathing?
Have you had a fever, severe headache, neck stiffness, or recent infection?
Have you recently started or increased any medication, especially an antipsychotic or medicine for nausea or vomiting?
Have you stopped taking any regular medication recently?
Have you used alcohol, recreational drugs, or been exposed to any poison recently?
Have you had loss of bladder control, tongue-biting, or prolonged confusion after an episode?
Were you able to walk and use both arms normally before this problem began?
